description: Application bundle: send one document with the account ID and the access token. kind names the document and npi the clinician (leave npi out for group_tin_letter). Send the file as file_base64: a PDF, JPG or PNG up to 3 MB, in a request of at most 4.4 MB (up to 4 MB as multipart form data to POST /v1/payer-follow-ups/{id}/documents). For caqh_authorization send caqh_id and caqh_access_granted true instead of a file. A document sent again before we review it replaces the earlier one; an accepted one stays. Returns the document's new status and the whole list.

access_token.description: The access_token payer_follow_up_request returned (shown once), or the token in an emailed link.

caqh_access_granted.description: caqh_authorization only: true once Licium has access to the clinician's CAQH profile.

caqh_id.description: caqh_authorization only: the clinician's CAQH provider ID, 5 to 10 digits.

file_base64.description: The file, base64 encoded: a PDF, JPG or PNG up to 3 MB, in a request of at most 4.4 MB. Not for caqh_authorization.

kind.description: The document, as payer_follow_up_documents lists it.

npi.description: The clinician's 10-digit NPI; leave it out for group_tin_letter.

name: payer_follow_up_document_send
title: Send one document of an application bundle
